headline: Training Arc: Cairn (Rock) takes on the league
rules: Cairn must beat all 7 other gyms, then Champion Volt, in one run — one lost best-of-3 sends him back to Gym 1. His team must stay all Rock-type: after each failed run he can change items, stat spreads, moves, abilities, or swap in another Rock-type, and a change only sticks if it proves itself on fresh battles. Volt learns from every title defense.
